changes.title: Keep the sort key you just changed visible
changes.text: When a table already has sorting, adding or reversing a secondary or tertiary key keeps that selected statistic in view instead of jumping back to the primary key. Reordering visible columns preserves vertical position without pretending that sorting changed.

changes.title: Multiple sort keys and finalized APK history checks
changes.text: Core regressions cover adding and reversing secondary keys and reordering sorted columns. Android menu-touch coverage now adds a far-right secondary key while a different primary key remains active. Prior history is accepted only from its successfully completed producing job and exact artifact, even while separate device checks are running.
